description: Dividend history and safety (SEC XBRL) — A US public company dividend record from its own SEC XBRL filings: annual dividends per share for up to 15 fiscal years, year-over-year change, 3/5/10-year growth (CAGR), consecutive increases, years without a cut, cuts (with likely stock-split artifacts separated out), payout ratio vs diluted EPS, total cash dividends paid, last 8 quarterly dividends, and a verdict LONG-TERM GROWER/GROWING/RAISED/FLAT/CUT/SUSPENDED OR STOPPED/NO DIVIDEND REPORTED. ticker or cik. Example: /v1/sec/dividends?ticker=KO Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: sec_dividends
